chunks: Aban, from Ziyad Al-Kunasi, who said:
Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: 'And the one who, when his father calls him, curses his father, and the one who, when his son answers him, strikes him.'
ai.seo_question: What is the reciprocal behavior between a father and son that Imam al-Sadiq highlights as a major sin?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights a corrosive cycle of familial discord where the father’s impulsive cursing and the son’s physical retaliation exemplify the breakdown of adab (etiquette) within the home. This reciprocal harshness is viewed in Shia scholarship as a precursor to greater sins, illustrating how minor breaches of respect can escalate into major transgressions that disrupt the spiritual harmony of the family unit.
